name: open-personal-agent
description: An open-source personal AI assistant you deploy to your own Cloudflare account.

scripts.deploy: pnpm build && wrangler deploy && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote
scripts.check: node scripts/check-boundaries.mjs && node scripts/check-builder-independence.mjs && node scripts/check-supply-chain.mjs && node scripts/generate-verify-guide.mjs --check

DB.description: The app's D1 database. Keep the suggested name, or use `<worker name>-db`.

FILES.description: The R2 bucket for uploaded files. Keep the suggested name, or use `<worker name>-files`.

OPA_MASTER_KEY.description: Key-encryption key: 32 random bytes, base64. Generate one with `openssl rand -base64 32` and **back it up**: losing it makes stored keys unrecoverable.

OPA_SESSION_SECRET.description: Signs session state: 32 random bytes, base64. Generate one with `openssl rand -base64 32`.

OPA_SETUP_TOKEN.description: One-time token that claims the new deployment at `/setup`: 32 random bytes, base64. Generate one with `openssl rand -base64 32` and keep it for the first visit.
